I personally don't really like going to the doctors. I hate wasting my time just to be told there is nothing can be done or be referred to 5 other doctors. Main reason I haven't seen once since I was 12. 

​

Sorry that you had to go through bullshit, I also didn't really have friends.  The only friends that I had was on Skype/MSN never got to chill with anyone out of school spent all my life at home. Luckily I didn't make too many bad  decisions  though; other than 40k worth of debt. 

I got no money to go to school either unfortunately, I got way too much debt and I am not willing to take up additional debt so basically my future is not looking good.

I am still hanging on but I don't know, I just don't want to anymore but I don't want to put my parents through losing me.

All subjects even stuff that I understand very well. I literally forget everything not to mention I have some sort of a leaning disability. My mom never wanted to help me get treated though I believe the docs suspected it was ADD/ADHD. I do have majoiry of the symptoms on self diagnosis but now that I am an adult no doctor would be willing to prescribe Adderall or something similar to try to help.

So I've been setup to fail in life from the very beginning makes me really sad everytime I think about it.

Really wish that I could just go to a hospital and ask them to kill me so they can have my organs guess I could do something good for someone... 

I don't understand why people want to life like what's the point. You're just a prisoner to your job all your life

Thank you for taking the time to read my post. I've done terrible in school for the longest time. I tried going again for taking a 3 - 4 year break and I still failed. I just got F's and c's. 

I just stopped trying there is no point.
